title: N.L. band Hey Rosetta! reuniting after near decade-long hiatus
summary: Hey Rosetta! has been asleep for a long, long time — but the St. John's band is ending a near decade-long hiatus.

image.caption: Hey Rosetta!, seen here in a file photo, has announced they will be reuniting for four shows in St. John's this February. (Hey Rosetta!)

blocks.text: Hey Rosetta! has been asleep for a long, long time — but the St. John's band is ending a near decade-long hiatus.
The band played their last show in 2017, but announced four shows at the Jag Soundhouse in St. John's in February, along with shows in Toronto and Montreal.
The seven-piece indie rock band consists of Tim Baker, Adam Hogan, Phil Maloney, Josh Ward, Kinley Dowling, Romesh Thavanathan and Mara Pellerin.
The Polaris Prize-winning band's debut album, Plan Your Escape, turns 20 years old this year.

items: Tim Baker didn't set out to make a Christmas record, but that was the jolly outcome

blocks.text: "We always thought we would get back together and play again someday. But of course our lives began orbiting around new projects and purposes, and to mobilise the will and energy and dedication to do the thing justice seemed almost impossible," Baker wrote in a letter published by the band, which announced the shows, on Tuesday.

"I screwed up the courage to ask Phil & Romesh, Adam & Josh, Kinley & Mara, and every one of them said yes right away … Why not go back into it, enjoy it & celebrate it for what it was, what it took to do, and what it gave."
